title: Concept: R dependency floor with two components
description: DESCRIPTION declares an `R (>= X.Y)` floor with no patch level, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision.
